description: This file defines the NavigationSectionStorage class, a Drupal plugin that manages navigation layout sections, routes, and permissions within the Drupal layout builder system.

classes.name: NavigationSectionStorage
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class that provides storage and management of navigation layout sections, routes, and permissions within the layout builder system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the plugin with configuration, plugin ID, plugin definition, and config factory.

methods.name: getStorageType
methods.description: Returns the plugin ID as the storage type.

methods.name: getStorageId
methods.description: Returns the constant storage ID for navigation blocks.

methods.name: getConfigName
methods.description: Returns the configuration name used for storing sections.

methods.name: getSections
methods.description: Retrieves the sections array, loading from config if not already loaded.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current sections to configuration and returns save status.

methods.name: buildRoutes
methods.description: Builds routes for the navigation section, including a form route for editing layout.

methods.name: deriveContextsFromRoute
methods.description: Derives context information from a route, specifically for navigation.

methods.name: buildLocalTasks
methods.description: Returns an empty array, indicating no local tasks.

methods.name: getLayoutBuilderUrl
methods.description: Generates a URL for the layout builder interface.

methods.name: getRedirectUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL to redirect to the layout builder.

methods.name: access
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to configure navigation layout.

methods.name: getContextsDuringPreview
methods.description: Returns contexts during preview, same as getContexts.

methods.name: isApplicable
methods.description: Indicates the storage is always applicable.

methods.name: getContextMapping
methods.description: Returns the context mapping for navigation.
